_readme: Y-22: hand-written session-length estimate per hub game, read by script.js for the title-card chip, the session-length filter and the onboarding quick-vs-deep pick. Tiers: short = about 5 minutes (Signal's own documented five-minute daily puzzle), medium = about 20 minutes (the eight climate games, tagged Quick on the hub), long = long-form (the deep-systems games, which are built to be played across many sittings). These are estimates by the site owner, not measured play times: edit a value here to change it. Kept in its own file because scripts/generate-last-updated.py rewrites game-manifest.json from scratch and would drop a hand-written field.
